riddle: To find out which comes next, the body is not enough. Assemble that which remains when it is gone.
progress_note: The linked sources document R1–R5. They do not establish an R6 completion.
source_scope: The 14 November editorial update covers 116 route records, 27 interpretations and 90 detailed breakdowns. The sheet preserves historical testing summaries; it is not an independent replay of every player experiment. Individually attributed reports remain separate from summaries and proposals.
disclosure: I made this archive to keep our Dead Man’s Hunt research in one place. I used ChatGPT and Sol to help analyze notes, organize findings, review sources and build the site. The assessments are my research priorities; original ideas and tests belong to the hunters credited in their sources.
